tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250zab lam thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'i mchod phreng rgyas par spro na/ 1$0000300

phyi mchod chu gnyis nyer spyod ni/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: lha rdzas las grub chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga: kun bzang rnam 'phrul phyi yi mchod par 'bul: zag med bde chen bskyed phyir bzhes nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru dharma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: nirma kā ya maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pādyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai bidya shabda pū dza ho: 'dod yon lnga ni/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: lha rdzas las grub 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga: kun bzang rnam 'phrul phyi yi mchod par 'bul: zag med bde chen bskyed phyir bzhes nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru dharma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: nirma kā ya maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra rū pa shabda gandhe ra sa sparshe kā ma gu ṇa pra tītstsha swā hā: nang mchod ni/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: rang byung lhun grub dbang po'i me tog sogs: drag po'i longs spyod nang gi mchod par 'bul: zag med bde chen bskyed phyir bzhes nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru dharma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: nirma kā ya maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā puṣpe dhū pe dī pe gandhe nai widya shabda pū dza ho: gsang mchod ni/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: bde stong mnyam sbyor rtog tshogs dbyings su bsgral: gnyis med rig pa gsang ba'i mchod par 'bul: zag med bde chen bskyed phyir bzhes nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru dharma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: nirma kā ya maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra dzñā na su kha ho: sman mchod ni/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: sku lnga ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar sman gyi mchod pa 'bul: zag med bde chen bskyed phyir bzhes nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: padma rdor 'chang rigs lnga'i thod phreng rtsal: gu ru mtshan brgyad lha sras mchog grub rgyal: sangs rgyas ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal la: sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: dri med kun dga' padma mdo sngags gling: rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i lha: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung gter bdag la: sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: dngos grub blang ba ni/ kā ya wā ka tsitta badzra a mṛta siddhi pha la ho: rakta'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: snang srid dmar gyi rgya mtsho chen por bskyil: chags bral bde stong rakta'i mchod pa 'bul: zag med bde chen bskyed phyir bzhes nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ma hā rakta khā hi: gtor mchod ni/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: snod bcud 'byor tshogs bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs: 'dod 'byung dpal gyi gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: zag med bde chen bskyed phyir bzhes nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ma hā ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi:
